title: Juniper and the Ghost
premise: Mara Fairweather, a whistle-blower living under four names, discovers her remote safe house has been listed for sale online — with photos of the interior that could only have been taken from inside. The breach forces her handlers to relocate her, but en route she learns the listing was bait: someone is hunting her through the very network that protects her. When a Russian defector surfaces claiming knowledge of the leak, Mara is ordered to help extract him before an intelligence summit convenes — even as evidence mounts that the defector himself is the trap. To survive, Mara must choose between loyalty to the handler who once saved her and the truth that will expose the mole inside her own protection detail, ending with her testifying at the summit while her found family of fellow ghosts covers her escape.
about_author: Theo Montrose is the pen name of a former security consultant who spent a decade advising on witness-protection logistics before turning to fiction. They write from an undisclosed location, naturally.

chapters.title: The Listing
chapters.summary: Mara, living as 'June Halloway,' scrolls a real-estate site at 3 a.m. and finds her safe house for sale — twelve photos, including her bedroom and the hidden floor safe. She photographs everything, wipes the house, and calls her emergency contact. POV: Mara. Beat: cold dread sharpening into survival instinct.

chapters.title: Four Names Deep
chapters.summary: Her handler, Aldous Vane, extracts her in a grain truck and interrogates her gently about who knew the address. Flashbacks reveal the incident that made her a whistle-blower. They relocate her to a coastal cottage with a new name. POV: Mara. Beat: fragile trust in the system that both saved and failed her.

chapters.title: The Man Who Wasn't Sold
chapters.summary: Mara digs into the realty firm and finds the listing agent doesn't exist — a shell built three weeks ago, funded through a company she recognizes from her whistle-blowing days. Someone from her past is directing the hunt. POV: Mara. Beat: the hunted becomes the investigator; resolve replaces fear.

chapters.title: Defector
chapters.summary: Vane summons her: a Russian cryptographer, Yuri Sokolov, wants to trade evidence about the mole for extraction before the Geneva summit. Vane assigns Mara to verify him — she's the only one who can recognize the documents. POV: alternating Mara/Vane. Beat: duty reasserting itself over her longing to disappear.

chapters.title: The Safe House Protocol
chapters.summary: Mara meets Yuri in a Vienna safe flat and finds his evidence credible — and personally devastating: the mole has access to protection protocols, meaning every safe house is compromised, including hers. POV: Mara. Beat: the walls of her found family closing in.

chapters.title: Bait
chapters.summary: Mara discovers the extraction route Vane proposed matches the pattern of the fake listing — the defector may be bait to draw her out, or Vane himself may be compromised. She tests Yuri with a fabricated detail and he passes. POV: Mara. Beat: paranoia vs. growing loyalty to Yuri.

chapters.title: Ghost Network
chapters.summary: Mara goes off-book, contacting two other protected witnesses — her found family of ghosts — who help her trace the shell company to an analyst inside Vane's own agency. But one of them stops answering. POV: Mara. Beat: love against duty; she chooses truth over obedience.

chapters.title: The Long Night
chapters.summary: Vane confronts Mara with her off-book activity; the missing witness is found dead. Vane offers her a deal: hand over Yuri's evidence and vanish forever. Mara realizes Vane is protecting her at the cost of the truth — or burying her. POV: Mara. Beat: the lowest moment; loyalty and truth at war.

chapters.title: Summit
chapters.summary: Mara and Yuri run a double extraction: she feeds Vane a false route while the ghost network moves Yuri through Geneva. The mole intercepts the decoy; Mara confronts the analyst in a parking garage and records his confession as his team closes in. POV: Mara. Beat: climax — courage, sacrifice, the recording as her only weapon.

chapters.title: Juniper, At Last
chapters.summary: At the summit, Mara testifies under her real name for the first time in years; the mole is arrested and Vane, cleared but diminished, chooses exile with her blessing. Yuri is granted asylum; the surviving ghosts gather quietly. Mara sleeps through the night. POV: Mara. Beat: resolution — truth chosen, family kept, rest earned.
